title: Village-de-Dieu Gang Members Attack Police in Kenscoff, Torch Armored Vehicle
detail: Gang members operating from Village-de-Dieu attacked Haitian National Police officers in Kenscoff on August 7, 2026, injuring several officers and setting fire to a PNH armored vehicle. The Armed Forces of Haiti (FAd'H) and local security brigades were deployed as reinforcement. The attack came exactly one month after the devastating July 7-9 Kenscoff massacre that killed 61 people, underscoring the commune's continued exposure to gang incursions despite reinforced patrols.

title: Kokorat San Ras Gang Massacres Dozen+ in Gros-Mornes, Artibonite
detail: The Kokorat San Ras gang attacked Gros-Mornes in the Artibonite department over the weekend of August 7-8, 2026, killing at least a dozen people according to local residents; the mayor confirmed the massacre. Artibonite has become the second-most affected department nationally, accounting for 381 fatalities (25.7% of national total) in 2026 year-to-date, driven by Gran Grif and Kokorat San Ras gang expansion along Route Nationale routes with negligible GSF coverage in the department.

media.caption: Kokorat San Ras gang massacres residents in Gros-Mornes, Artibonite
